items.name: ScalarBuffer
items.summary: A strongly-typed [`Buffer`] supporting zero-copy cloning and slicing

methods.name: claim
methods.summary: Claim memory used by this buffer in the provided memory pool.

methods.name: from_iter
methods.signature: fn from_iter<I: IntoIterator<Item = T>>(iter: I) -> Self

methods.name: is_empty
methods.summary: Returns if the buffer is empty

methods.name: len
methods.summary: Returns the number of elements in the buffer

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(buffer: Buffer, offset: usize, len: usize) -> Self
methods.summary: Create a new [`ScalarBuffer`] from a [`Buffer`], and an `offset` and `length` in units of `T`

methods.name: new_unchecked
methods.summary: Unsafe function to create a new [`ScalarBuffer`] from a [`Buffer`]. Only use for testing purpose.

methods.name: ptr_eq
methods.summary: Returns true if this [`ScalarBuffer`] is equal to `other`, using pointer comparisons to determine buffer equality. This is cheaper than `PartialEq::eq` but may return false when the arrays are logically equal

methods.name: slice
methods.signature: fn slice(&self, offset: usize, len: usize) -> Self
methods.summary: Returns a zero-copy slice of this buffer with length `len` and starting at `offset`
